findings.text: The new condition only forces x64 on Apple Silicon for versions below 14.17.0 and for 15.x. Versions 14.17.0 through 14.x (for example 14.21.3) now keep arm64 on darwin. Node publishes no darwin-arm64 binaries before v16, as the patch's own comment says. So `nvm install 14.21.3` on an M1 Mac requests a nonexistent node-v14.21.3-darwin-arm64 tarball and fails with a 404. Before this change it fell back to x64. The condition should stay `nvm_version_greater '16.0.0' "${VERSION}"`.

The patch calls `nvm_version_greater_than_or_equal_to`. I did not check that this helper exists in nvm.sh. If it doesn't, the call fails and the 15.x branch silently evaluates false, so 15.x on arm64 would also stop falling back to x64.
